interpretation: regen_kus_matching_terms is an UPPER BOUND funnel number, NOT a work order size: domain term maps contain broadly-occurring terms (e.g. 'gradient descent', 'learning rate'), so a term hit alone is not evidence of domain participation. Dossier extension MUST go through the same discipline the dossiers were built with: overlap-candidates (CAP-013) between the new KUs and each domain's existing concept KU sets, then semantic classification, then dossier regeneration with the ext006 rule set. The committed dossiers regenerate byte-identically from their inputs (scripts/ext006_dossiers.py --check, exit 0, 2026-10-28).
